questions.question: How many hours had Patryk worked before he closed the laptop?
answers: Eight
Ten
Fourteen
Twenty-four
questions.explanation: The opening states that he had worked fourteen hours.

questions.question: What does Patryk write on the first page of the notebook?
answers: That he cannot remember when he last felt truly well and truly breathed
An outline for tomorrow’s presentation
A list of medicines and sleep hours
The address of a sleep clinic
questions.explanation: The first entry is about forgetting when he last felt well and really breathed.

questions.question: Where did Patryk’s notebook come from?
answers: He bought it in a bookshop
He found it at the office
A coworker gave it to him
His wife gave it to him for his birthday three years ago
questions.explanation: An old notebook from his wife’s birthday gift three years ago is in the drawer.

questions.question: In the traffic jam, which question does Patryk ask himself out loud?
answers: Will I make it to the presentation?
Do I have to stress about this?
Why is the boss never satisfied?
When did I last sleep well?
questions.explanation: In the jam he repeats the podcast question about whether he must stress about it.

questions.question: By the end of the story, how does Patryk understand stress?
answers: As an enemy to defeat with coffee and overtime
As a reason to change jobs immediately
As information from the body; the answer is pausing and breathing
As a signal to return to the presentation that same night
questions.explanation: The closing reflection treats stress as information answered by stopping and breathing.

questions.question: How does the story end?
answers: Patryk returns to the laptop and finishes an email to his boss
He goes for a run across Warsaw
He throws away the notebook and buys a new one
He lies down beside his wife and falls asleep calmly
questions.explanation: He closes the notebook, lies down beside his wife, and falls asleep calmly.
